knownGaps.title: WorldState.transact and direct projection path do not represent the accepted Ordering/Transaction/Outbox/Projection Barrier architecture
knownGaps.requiredDecision: choose the minimum transaction/event seam that E0 must implement without prematurely building later persistence

knownGaps.title: Current WorldContract/WorldState are actor-centric while accepted Selection/Interaction architecture requires stable Runtime Object and incarnation identity
knownGaps.requiredDecision: define the minimum runtime entity/object identity boundary used by selection, interaction and movement

knownGaps.title: Spatial Query is a required shared boundary but no Greenfield system/module/function contract represents it
knownGaps.requiredDecision: introduce a typed snapshot-bound spatial query boundary before Selection/Movement/Interaction implementations depend on ad-hoc Workspace queries

knownGaps.title: MovementDomain alone does not represent accepted Navigation Planner, Movement Coordinator and Movement Executor boundaries
knownGaps.requiredDecision: define repository-side movement policy versus Roblox-runtime pathfinding/planner/executor boundaries before E0 MovementDomain is implemented

knownGaps.title: ContextActionController plus ExplorationDomain does not explicitly provide Interaction Capability Query and viewer-safe Contextual Option Projection
knownGaps.requiredDecision: define interaction provider/query/option projection boundary before X1

knownGaps.title: Accepted RuleExecution/Pending Execution orchestration boundary is absent from current Greenfield core
